BiblicalUsage: Cheresh covers silence, secrecy and the craftsman's skill, three uses of one root that meet in the text. The spies go into Jericho secretly, Isaiah names the cunning artificer among the leaders taken away, and the valley of craftsmen is named for the workmen who lived there.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe quiet work and secret counsel both have their place, and Scripture marks the difference between hiding for God and hiding from Him. I hold that the craftsman's quiet skill and the spy's quiet errand both serve God when the heart behind them is true.
